title: The Direnni Seal of the Bjoulsae Mouth
summary: Navigate the cutthroat rivalry between Castle Wayrest's chancery and the merchant guild-lords when a sunken Direnni treaty-coffer is dredged up from the bay.

npcs.name: Chancellor Perrault
npcs.greet: If you have business at the counting-houses, traveller, best keep your hand on your hilt. The harbour syndicates and the Crown are an inch from open war.
talk: Dredgers at the Bjoulsae mouth hauled up an adamant-bound Direnni coffer containing the original Balfiera toll-exemptions.
Before the Knights of the Rose could escort it to Castle Wayrest, someone opened the flood-gates into the Wayrest Sewers and vanished with the coffer.

npcs.name: Dame Vivienne of the Rose
npcs.greet: The guild-lords blame the Crown, and the Crown blames the dockers. Meanwhile the real thieves move through the tide-drains beneath our feet.
talk: Factor Moreau of the Merchant Council paid smugglers in the Wayrest Sewers to spirit the Direnni coffer out to Hawkfield Caverns.
Search the sluices in the Wayrest Sewers and meet Wharf-Master Luc at the outfall.

npcs.name: Wharf-Master Luc
npcs.greet: Hold your torch high! The tide is rising in the brick culverts, and Moreau's hired blades left caltrops on the catwalks.
talk: Factor Moreau didn't just hire cutthroats—he made a pact with the Tamarilyn sea-witches in Hawkfield Caverns to crack the Direnni ward-lock.
Clear the smugglers from Oakhurst Cave and Hawkfield Caverns before they open the coffer!

npcs.name: Archivist Celine
npcs.greet: You found the Direnni coffer intact? By Akatosh's hourglass, half the counting-houses in Wayrest would have burned for what lies inside.
talk: The charter binds both Crown and Guild to share the Balfiera light-dues—no wonder Factor Moreau wanted the wax melted.

story_wr_sewer_sluice: Wharf-Master Luc: Look at the bronze grating—pried open with a counting-house winch, and the mortar still wet with salt-slime.
Dame Vivienne of the Rose: And here is a ledger-tag from Factor Moreau's own lighter-barge.
Wharf-Master Luc: They rowed the Direnni coffer west along the marsh shore toward Oakhurst Cave and Hawkfield Caverns!
story_wr_oakhurst_ritual: Hag-Sister Merisande: Elven adamant does not yield to iron chisels, merchant! It drinks salt and drowned men's breath!
Dame Vivienne of the Rose: Break her circle before the Direnni ward shatters!
story_wr_hawkfield_finale: High Factor Moreau: With the Direnni charter in my strongroom, the King of Wayrest will beg the Guilds for every ship that crosses the bar!
Dame Vivienne of the Rose: You would drown the harbour in blood for a three-percent toll-rebate, Moreau!
High Factor Moreau: Three percent of the Iliac Bay is an empire, knight! Guards—kill them!

quests.title: The Dredged Charter of Balfiera
quests.summary: Speak with Dame Vivienne at Castle Wayrest and trace the stolen Direnni coffer into the Wayrest Sewers.
intro: An ancient Direnni treaty-coffer dredged from the Bjoulsae mouth was stolen from the customs quay before the Knights of the Rose could secure it.
Confer with Dame Vivienne at Castle Wayrest and descend into the Wayrest Sewers to inspect the flood-sluice.
complete: In the Wayrest Sewers, Wharf-Master Luc and Dame Vivienne proved that High Factor Moreau smuggled the coffer out by barge.

journal.start: Chancellor Perrault sent me to Castle Wayrest and the Wayrest Sewers to trace the stolen Direnni coffer.
journal.done: We discovered High Factor Moreau's barge-marks at the sewer sluice.

quests.title: Tide-Witches of the Reed-Fen
quests.summary: Pursue the smugglers to Oakhurst Cave and defeat Hag-Sister Merisande of the Tamarilyn Coven.
intro: High Factor Moreau hired the Tamarilyn sea-coven in Oakhurst Cave to dissolve the Direnni ward-seals on the coffer.
Enter Oakhurst Cave and stop Hag-Sister Merisande before the ward is broken.
complete: Hag-Sister Merisande was defeated, and her half-forged key revealed that Moreau took the coffer to Hawkfield Caverns.

journal.start: I must enter Oakhurst Cave and stop Hag-Sister Merisande from breaking the Direnni seal.
journal.done: I defeated Hag-Sister Merisande in Oakhurst Cave and traced the coffer to Hawkfield Caverns.

objectives.text: Track the lighter-barge to Oakhurst Cave

stages.objective: Track the lighter-barge to Oakhurst Cave

quests.title: The Factor's Contraband
quests.summary: Infiltrate Hawkfield Caverns, confront High Factor Moreau, and reclaim the Direnni treaty-coffer.
intro: High Factor Moreau has gathered his mercenary company inside Hawkfield Caverns to pry open the Direnni coffer.
Storm Hawkfield Caverns and defeat High Factor Moreau.
complete: High Factor Moreau fell in Hawkfield Caverns, and the adamant Direnni coffer was recovered unbroken.

journal.start: I must enter Hawkfield Caverns and defeat High Factor Moreau to recover the Direnni coffer.
journal.done: I defeated High Factor Moreau and secured the Direnni coffer.

objectives.text: Confront High Factor Moreau in the cavern vault

stages.objective: Confront High Factor Moreau in the cavern vault

quests.title: The Concord of Castle Wayrest
quests.summary: Deliver the Direnni coffer to Archivist Celine at Castle Wayrest and report the concord to Chancellor Perrault.
intro: With the Direnni coffer in hand, return to Castle Wayrest so Archivist Celine can unseal the Balfiera charter before both Crown and Guild.
Present the coffer at Castle Wayrest and inform Chancellor Perrault in the city.
complete: The Direnni charter confirmed shared customs rights across the Bjoulsae mouth, averting civil war on the Wayrest quays.

journal.start: I must bring the Direnni coffer to Archivist Celine at Castle Wayrest and report to Chancellor Perrault.
journal.done: The Direnni charter was unsealed at Castle Wayrest, restoring peace between the Crown and the Merchant Guilds.
